doctor_ubuntu.fixture_location_reason: The normal Ubuntu lab temporary directory is tmpfs; doctor uses an isolated disk-backed user-cache directory and removes it after the run.

measurement_notes: No run qualified as quiet. A quiet run requires every observed host sample to have no other active heavy.sh slot and one-minute load below the logical CPU count. Unknown telemetry disqualifies quiet.

Samples record load averages in one/five/fifteen-minute order, one-second CPU idle, free memory excluding cache, live heavy slots and live queue tickets. Samples occur at start, periodically every five seconds, and end.
Darwin CPU idle uses the last interval from iostat; Linux uses the idle-counter delta from /proc/stat. The earlier top-based probe and its timeouts are preserved in historical attempts.
Benchmark readiness uses the capture commit barrier, replica durable cursor, and exact integrity/count verification once; it no longer runs repeated integrity checks during capture.
FTS timings are 100 repeated gateway HTTP queries after integrity verification, with 200 matches each in a 200000-message synthetic dataset.
RSS and WAL values are end samples after the benchmark queries, before final automatic integrity checks; they are not maxima.
The default Ubuntu benchmark data directory is tmpfs; the doctor encryption fixture is disk-backed.
Clock difference is local receive time minus authenticated gateway frame time and includes feed transit; it is not an NTP offset estimate.
Latency endpoints use the lab monotonic clock. Replica runs use the SSH tunnel; no direct-TCP timeout is attempted by default.

Original historical attempt SHAs are preserved across rebases; equivalent unit commit subjects are mapped in implementation.historical_rebase_lineage. Canonical final baselines retain their actual run SHAs.
Top-level baselines and summaries retain the pre-integration runs. post_rebase_integration contains the final combined-code verification and baseline measurements.
spec_deviations: No product SPEC deviation. The doctor lab fixture uses a private disk-backed Ubuntu cache directory instead of tmpfs so encryption can be tested; cleanup is automatic.
proposed_spec_updates: Add CORE-DOCTOR at sim/replica levels to SPEC 18.1 and include the replica CORE-BENCH level.
Document host-condition sampling and the bounded require-quiet fallback in the evidence section.
open_items: No quiet window was available during these runs; measurements are explicitly non-quiet.
The new gateway-initiated connection mode and CORE-GATEWAY-DIALS remain a separate unit, per leader instruction.
The initial full-suite failures are retained; the final integrated full sim suite passed 51/51.
